containers.name: runtime
command:
import base64,zlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,time
r=pathlib.Path('/tmp/identity-loss3');r.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
files=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))
for name,data in files.items():(r/name).write_text(data)
p=subprocess.run(['python','-u',str(r/'check_cpu.py')],cwd=r)
(r/'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'returncode':p.returncode}))
print('CPU_CHECK_EXIT',p.returncode,flush=True)
time.sleep(1200)
